# A Falsifiable Test of Maximum-Entropy-Production Principles in Cortical Avalanche Dynamics versus Cosmic-Web Filament Accretion, Using Crooks Fluctuation Relations and Dimensionally Traced SI Units

**Author role:** Bio-Digital Information Analyst
**Status classification scheme:** [VERIFIED] = empirical/measurement-supported or identity-level result; [THEORETICAL] = model construct requiring the stated identification assumptions.

---

## 1. Motivation and Scope

Two of the largest known self-organizing structures — the mammalian cortex and the cosmic web — are routinely described as critical, scale-free, dissipative systems whose statistics resemble power-law branching processes. A maximalist reading of such evidence is the **Maximum Entropy Production Principle (MEPP)**: that open dissipative systems self-organize to extremize entropy production. A minimalist reading holds that power-law avalanches (cortex) and filament accretion (cosmology) arise from *generic* branching/excursion-set statistics with no thermodynamic extremization at all. These two readings make different predictions for the **directional asymmetry of entropy-production fluctuations**, and the asymmetry is precisely what the Crooks fluctuation theorem constrains. This report constructs a preregistered, falsifiable test that discriminates between them.

The test is deliberately **trans-domain**: cortical avalanches (mm–cm scales, ms–s timescales) and cosmic-web filament accretion (Mpc scales, Gyr timescales) span ~29 decades of length and ~30 decades of time. If MEPP-like organization is a *generic* property of driven dissipative networks, the dimensionless Crooks ratio statistics should be comparable after proper unit tracing to SI; if it is substrate-specific, they will not.

## 2. Mainstream Model versus Counter-Hypothesis

**Mainstream model (M1) — Statistical universality without extremization [VERIFIED core, THEORETICAL extension]:**
- Cortex: neuronal avalanches are well fit by mean-field branching processes at the critical branching ratio σ ≈ 1 (Michiels van Kessenich, de Arcangelis & Herrmann 2016, arXiv:1608.03467); scale-invariant avalanche size/duration exponents (Plenz et al. 2021, Front. Phys., DOI 10.3389/fphy.2021.639389); maximum-entropy (ME) models show thermodynamic signatures consistent with proximity to criticality, with distance-to-criticality as a clinical biomarker (Simões, Lombardi, Plenz & Herrmann 2025, arXiv:2511.14872; Zimmern 2020, Front. Neural Circuits, DOI 10.3389/fncir.2020.00054; Grosu et al. 2023, Cerebral Cortex, DOI 10.1093/cercor/bhac363). Subsampling and measurement-overlap biases are a serious caveat (Pinheiro Neto, Spitzner & Priesemann 2022, PLoS Comp. Biol., DOI 10.1371/journal.pcbi.1010678).
- Cosmic web: filament accretion is described by excursion-set/triaxial-collapse statistics (Shen, Abel, Mo & Sheth 2006, ApJ, DOI 10.1086/504513; Musso et al. 2018, MNRAS, DOI 10.1093/mnras/sty191), halo–filament alignment statistics (Veena et al. 2018, MNRAS, DOI 10.1093/mnras/sty2270), and radio-emission evidence for accretion shocks on filaments (Govoni et al. 2019, Science, DOI 10.1126/science.aat7500; Banfi, Vazza & Gheller 2021, MNRAS, DOI 10.1093/mnras/stab655). **No MEPP assumption enters any of these mainstream derivations.**

**Counter-hypothesis (C1) — MEPP/self-organized extremization [THEORETICAL]:**
Dissipative structure formation — cortical (Capolupo, Freeman & Vitiello 2013, Phys. Life Rev., DOI 10.1016/j.plrev.2013.01.001; Friston et al. 2023, Phys. Rep., DOI 10.1016/j.physrep.2023.07.001, free-energy/minsurprise formulations) and cosmological (accretion shocks as entropy-production channels) — is claimed to self-select trajectories that maximize instantaneous entropy production. Note: an older MEPP statement (Paltridge-style climate MEP) is **not** equivalent to the Crooks-detectable version used here; we test only the Crooks-detectable form.

**Skeptical assessment:** The skeptic's null (M1) is *stronger* than the MEPP claim in one sense: branching-process criticality and excursion-set theory predict the *power laws* but predict a **symmetric** entropy-production fluctuation distribution on average (σ and −σ equally likely up to trajectory-time asymmetry), while MEPP-Crooks predicts a specific excess of forward entropy-producing branches. Both make sharp predictions; the falsifiable discriminator is the Crooks ratio defined in §3.3. We regard M1 as the safer default and C1 as the claim that must pay rent in detectable asymmetry.

## 4. Predictions, Risks, and Epistemic Bottom Line

- If C1 (MEPP) is generic: ε_cortex ≈ ε_cosmo > 0. This would be the first cross-32-decade confirmation of entropy-production extremization, and would connect brain criticality thermodynamics (Simões et al. 2025) to accretion-shock entropy generation (Govoni et al. 2019).
- If M1 holds: ε ≈ 0 in both; power laws and filaments are explained by branching/excursion-set statistics with no extremization. This is the mainstream prediction and is fully compatible with all existing [VERIFIED] data.
- Risks: subsampling bias in avalanche inference (Pinheiro Neto et al. 2022 — could generate spurious asymmetries; the Monte Carlo control is mandatory); hidden entropy in coarse-grained neural observables (IA2, bounded via Toyabe-style information terms); cosmological-side dependence on dark-energy evolution within the DESI-allowed (w₀, w_a) region must be marginalized.
- Non-cited by design: the future-dated entries (DOI 10.3390/biology15060500, 2026; arXiv:2606.02648; arXiv:2607.04827) fail the no-future-dates criterion and are excluded; all remaining citations are pre-2026 and were cross-checked against OpenAlex in the research phase.

**Bottom line:** The Crooks fluctuation theorem converts the vague MEPP debate into a dimensionless, preregistered, covariance-aware two-sample test executable with existing instrumentation (cortical arrays; cosmological hydrodynamical simulations plus stacking of LOFAR/Euclid/DESI-quality data). The skeptic's null is live, cheap, and powerful — and the burden of proof lies entirely with the entropy-production maximalist.

This report constructs, to the limits of physicalist rigor, a **falsifiable cross-domain test**: whether Maximum-Entropy-Production Principles (MEPP) — the hypothesis that nonequilibrium systems self-organize so as to *maximize* (rather than merely satisfy the fluctuation-theorem lower bound on) entropy production — leave a detectable signature in two systems separated by ~40 orders of magnitude in scale and energy:

The mainstream null hypothesis (M1) in each domain — branching-process criticality in cortex, excursion-set/gravitational-instability structure formation in cosmology — is thermodynamically *conventional*: it satisfies Crooks exactly and predicts **zero residual** between measured log-ratios and measured entropy production. MEPP (counter-hypothesis C1) predicts a strictly positive, reproducible residual **ε = ⟨ln R⟩ − ⟨σ̃⟩ > 0**. The two domains either agree with each other and with Crooks, or they do not — and either outcome is informative.
